t: The 4lite Advantage outdoor LED floodlight provides powerful and efficient security lighting for various applications. Its robust aluminium body and tempered glass diffuser ensure durability, making it suitable for both domestic and commercial outdoor installations. Featuring an integrated IP44 PIR sensor, this 20W floodlight delivers 1700 lumens of cool white 4000K light, ideal for illuminating driveways, gardens, or commercial premises. The sensor offers a 120° detection angle and a 10m range, enhancing property security. With a 30,000-hour lifespan and adjustable height and angle, this mains-powered unit is a reliable lighting solution.
